hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was rolled out from off to on starting at 22:47 (139 off / 61 on that minute, fully on by 22:48). The enabled code path divides by zero on the account page, producing ZeroDivisionError on ~33% of requests, matching the error-rate step from ~1.5% to ~33%.

supporting_evidence.claim: INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations (every minute 22:40-22:46, with only sporadic UpstreamTimeout errors and 0-3% error rate)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
error_rate 0.015 at 22:46 -> 0.095 at 22:47 -> 0.33 at 22:48, latency unchanged (p50 ~40ms, p95 ~220ms)
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-15T20:00:00Z to 2026-09-15T22:47:00Z: (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a code change shipped earlier but dormant behind the flag could mean the defect arrived by deployment rather than by the toggle. However, the change log shows no deploys in the ~3 hours before onset, so this is weakly supported.
